_comment: Pre-registered connections, imported by pgAdmin on first start.
Host is 'db', not 'localhost': pgAdmin runs inside the compose network, so it resolves the
service name. 'localhost:25432' is the host-side mapping and is unreachable from in there —
that mistake is the usual reason a manual registration fails.
No password is stored here. pgAdmin prompts on first connect; the value is in

1.Name: RegOps dev (regops)
1.Comment: Owner role — migrations run as this. Full read/write, including audit_log.

2.Name: RegOps test (regops_test)
2.Comment: Integration-suite database. Truncated and rewritten by tests — do not keep work here.

3.Name: RegOps dev (regops_app, least privilege)
3.Comment: What the services actually connect as. UPDATE/DELETE on audit_log is denied here (ADR-0011); connect as this to see the append-only guarantee hold rather than assume it.
